messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU pool 'inference-fast' high queue growth (P1). Alerting on-call (maya).

maya: acked. seeing steady queue growth and 503s from routing layer. investigating.

maya: quick metrics snapshot:
```
GPU pool inference-fast: pending_queue=120 -> 460 over last 12m
avg_latency_tail=2.1s -> 4.6s
gpu_util=92% (memory 98%)
autoscaler: desired=6 current=6 max=6
```

ops-tilly: autoscaler hit maxReplicas=6, never scaled. looks like rollout increased per-request memory.

sam: which rollout? any recent model deployments in that fleet?

maya: deploy-bot shows a canary rollout 23m ago: model-id redwood/llm-std@v2.7 weight=20%. change: default context_limit=8192 (was 4096).

platform-liz: ah — v2.7 has an eager kv-cache allocation strategy that allocs larger KV per token. combined with longer context => memory footprint doubled.

maya: confirmed via pod logs: OOM reservations spiking, instance-level free memory < 3GB. autoscaler correctly did not add nodes because we hit a configured maxReplicas.

ops-tilly: immediate mitigations: 1) pause rollout 2) reduce canary weight to 0 3) bump pool maxReplicas temporarily 4) enable per-tenant rate-limits for public endpoints.

sam: agree. I'm going to set rollout weight back to previous version and push emergency config.

deploy-bot: CI deploy rollback triggered by @sam: rollback redwood/llm-std@v2.6 -> weight=100% (change id: d-ff32).

maya: executing emergency scale up for pool; running infra command:
```
infra scale-gpu-pool --name=inference-fast --min=3 --desired=10 --max=12 --reason="incident 1769123456"
```

ops-tilly: note: underlying cluster has 2 spare GPUs in us-west; autoscaler will take ~6-8m to provision new nodes.

maya: applying temporary per-key throttle:
```
redwood rate-limit set --route=/v1/generate --global=200rps --per-key=10rps --reason="incident mitigation"
```

cs-john: CS note: we have 3 high-traffic customers experiencing elevated error rates (acct: A-211, B-77, C-303). Notifying them now, ETA for mitigation ~8-12m.

platform-liz: also flipping fallback policy: route excess traffic to dedicated pool 'inference-stable' that runs older quantized model. config: 
```
routing policy add --from=inference-fast --to=inference-stable --when=queue>100 --max-rate=50rps
```

maya: after rollback and rate-limits: queue dropped from 460 -> 90 in ~9m, 503s down from 17% -> 2%. GPU mem pressure easing.

ops-tilly: autoscaler now scaling: current=6 -> desired=9 (provisioning). keep max bumped until postmortem.

maya: customer impact summary:
- window: 1769123456 -> 1769127800 (~73m)
- elevated error rate and latency for ~40m, peak queue growth 460
- affected customers: A-211,B-77,C-303 (rate-limited, degraded throughput)

cs-john: sending status update to customers with mitigation steps and ETA.

sam: root cause hypothesis: v2.7 changed default context_limit and an eager kv-cache strategy, doubling per-request memory and reducing throughput; autoscaler constraints (maxReplicas) prevented automatic mitigation.

platform-liz: follow-ups to prevent recurrence:
- add rollout guard that simulates memory footprint for new model variants across typical context distributions
- autoscaler: remove hard low maxReplicas for inference-fast or add soft burst capacity in other pools
- add circuit-breaker that falls back to quantized variant when mem pressure > 90%
- augment canary rollout to include per-second seq_len distribution tests

maya: logging for postmortem captured. I'll hand off to @ops-tilly for overnight watch. oncall handoff in 15.

ops-tilly: taking oncall. I'll keep maxReplicas=12 until tomorrow 15:00 UTC and monitor queue/503.

incident-bot: Incident declared: INC-2026-1769123456. Severity=P1. Runbook invoked: gpu-capacity-exhaustion.

maya: quick note for postmortem: include exact change in model config, test harness to replay production seq_len distribution, and a migration plan for any model that increases default context.

sam: adding action items to tracker:
- ACTION-1 (sam): revert default context in model config and add test suite (due 2026-03-15)
- ACTION-2 (platform-liz): add mem-footprint sim in model onboarding (due 2026-03-10)
- ACTION-3 (ops-tilly): relax autoscaler caps and add emergency pool (due 2026-03-09)
- ACTION-4 (cs-john): notify impacted customers with credits and RCA (due 2026-03-11)

cs-john: will draft customer messages and post in #customer-success after this thread.

ops-tilly: handing to morning shift. leaving monitors: queue>80 -> page oncall, 503>1% -> page.

maya: thanks all. closing active mitigation. moving to incident review. :white_check_mark:

platform-liz: note for PM/product: avoid silent defaults that materially change resource usage.

sam: agree — we'll add a product gating checklist for model runtime defaults.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1769123456 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
